description: The panel follows the status, the Quit question and the notes as events, fits its window to its content, reads the status and the new notes, opens the other windows or quits, opens the Pause OCR menu of its OCR row (Rust builds the tray's pause items and pauses for the one picked) and ends a pause with Resume OCR Now. No window has shell access: every call of the notedown program is made in Rust.
